name: Record Keeper
shortDescription: Explore music, build playlists, and take your audio on the road.
subtitle: Playlists, Lyrics & CarPlay
fullDescription:
Record Keeper is a home for music and the people who love it.

Explore artists and discographies, follow the lyrics, make playlists, and keep track of your listening. Artists can publish licensed music directly for their audience. Upload your own audio for personal playback across devices.

On Android Auto, browse artists, songs, playlists, and downloads with the car's familiar music controls. Stream artist-licensed songs and your own uploaded audio, or download available audio to your phone before a drive. Pause, skip, shuffle, and resume through native media controls, including while your phone screen is off.

The phone catalog also offers foreground YouTube playback. YouTube-only songs cannot be played through the native car player or downloaded. Native audio availability depends on an artist's license or your personal upload. Spotify Premium playback is not included.

Use your existing Suffering Jukebox or Listening Party account. Signing in is optional for listening to artist-licensed music; your account enables personal uploads, saved playlists, and listening history.

Record Keeper is a Johnny Outlaw LLC project.
promotionalText: Explore artists' discographies, follow the lyrics, and take your own uploaded audio into CarPlay. Free, with no account needed to listen.
releaseNotes: First Record Keeper release: native audio playback, Android Auto browsing, offline audio downloads, and shared music accounts.
reviewNotes: The app bundles its phone UI and has a native media service; it is not a remote website wrapper. Car playback exposes only artist-licensed or personally uploaded audio. Public artist-licensed audio needs no sign-in. Settings > Account > Delete account initiates account-data deletion. Reviewer account credentials should be supplied securely through the store console. Test Android Auto with artists, songs, playlists synced from the phone, and downloads. Spotify Premium connection is disabled. Apple reviewers: CarPlay uses the new Record Keeper bundle ID and requires its own enabled capability/provisioning profile.
appleFullDescription:
Record Keeper is a home for music and the people who love it. Explore artists and their discographies, follow lyrics, build playlists, and keep track of your listening.

MAKE MUSIC YOURS
Create playlists from your discoveries and return to your saved queue. Sign in to keep your playlists, hearts, and listening history across devices.

FOLLOW THE SONG
Read lyrics alongside foreground playback through the official YouTube player.

TAKE YOUR OWN AUDIO WITH YOU
Upload audio for personal listening. Supported personal uploads and artist-licensed recordings can play in the background, on the lock screen, and in CarPlay. Download supported audio for offline listening. YouTube videos play in the foreground and are not downloaded.

LISTEN TOGETHER
Open a live room and share a listening session with friends.

Browsing and public playback do not require an account. An account is needed to save personal playlists, listening history, and uploads.
appleWhatsNew: Heart songs right from the player, including the compact player at the bottom of the screen, and see how many people loved them. Play All in Explore now plays artists and playlists in order. Hearts save more reliably.
